description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three models—ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L—across different steps (100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000) in a text generation task using a diffusion language model. The x-axis represents the step number, while the y-axis shows the ROUGE score, with values increasing from left to right. Each step has three bars corresponding to the three ROUGE metrics: ROUGE-1 (light blue with diagonal lines), ROUGE-2 (light green with dots), and ROUGE-L (orange with dots). The ROUGE-1 scores increase steadily from 6.3 at step 100 to 41.2 at step 2000. ROUGE-2 scores start at 0.1 at step 100 and rise to 19.1 at step 2000. ROUGE-L scores begin at 3.0 at step 100 and reach 33.4 at step 2000. The chart shows that all three metrics improve with increasing steps, with ROUGE-L consistently having the highest scores, followed by ROUGE-1, and then ROUGE-2. The legend is positioned above the chart, clearly identifying each model type by its color and pattern.
